name: Twin Pines
source:
Follow Nico, a young arctic fox with a troubled past as he investigates his hometown of Twin Pine's strange properties, and why his family and most of the other townsfolk packed up and moved to Cherry City four years ago after receiving a mysterious check from a pharmaceuticals company who had just shut down their factory in the town. As he explores Twin Pines, set on solving the mystery behind why they left and the strangeness of the town, he and his friends stumble upon something no normal person was meant to see, and must now fight for their lives and sanity against this insurmountably powerful threat and discover a way out before their lives are claimed by this mysterious static.

[From [url=https://twin-pines-team.itch.io/twin-pines]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随尼科，一只有着麻烦的过去的年轻北极狐，调查他的家乡双子松的奇怪属性，以及为什么他的家人和大多数其他镇民在四年前收到一家刚刚关闭镇上工厂的制药公司的神秘支票后，收拾行李搬到了樱桃城。当他探索双松树，着手解开他们离开背后的谜团和这个小镇的陌生之处时，他和他的朋友们偶然发现了一些正常人不应该看到的东西，现在必须为自己的生命和理智而战，对抗这个难以克服的强大威胁，并在他们的生命被这种神秘的静电夺走之前找到出路。

[来自[url=https://twin-pines-team.itch.io/twin-pines]Itch.io[/url]]
